banner.text: Two September competitions start Sept 1 — “All In” for Life and Steak or Burgers. Rules are on the Competitions tab; All-In ante is due Sept 4.

news.title: Two September competitions — “All In” for Life and Steak or Burgers
news.body: September 1 kicks off two district competitions, both running through September 30. “All In” for Life is back: a $50 ante and 3 written life apps earns a seat at the Texas Hold ‘Em table, with a district pot contribution of $1,000 that rises to $2,500 at 85 written apps — commit and pay by September 4. The Steak or Burgers team battle moves to points: 1 point per quote and 5 per new business policy at the agency level, two teams, and the winners eat Prime steak. Full rules are in Competitions.

news.title: Jeffrey Pechacek qualifies for Jamaica
news.body: Jeffrey Pechacek has cleared both Jamaica bars at $47,224 of life premium and 31 I&P, joining Steven Tindell ($64,702 · 45 I&P). Matt Hodges has the premium and is 5 I&P from qualifying. Standings as of August 30 are in Competitions.

news.body: The 2026 Quote & Sales Tracker through August 14 and YTD Life Results as of August 30 are in Reports. Caleb Milne leads YTD NBNH at 372 with Steven Tindell close behind at 368. On life, the district is at 233 I&P and $263,701.

competitions.title: “All In” for Life — Texas Hold ‘Em Life Promo
competitions.prize: Cash pot — top five hands paid
competitions.description: A $50 ante and 3 written life apps earns your seat at the table, and every life app written earns an additional playing card — the more apps you write, the better your odds of a great poker hand. We play one hand of Texas Hold ‘Em: best hand takes 40% of the pot, then 25%, 20%, 10% and 5% for second through fifth. Antes go straight into the pot and the district office adds $1,000, rising to $2,500 once the district writes 85 total apps. Write your 3 apps and take none of the pot and your $50 ante is refunded. Apps must show on the Life Performance Tracker and be written September 1–30 to count. Commitment and ante are due by September 4 — checks payable to Brandon Parks at the district office, 213A Old Hewitt Road, Waco, TX 76712. Disputes are settled at the District Manager’s discretion.

competitions.title: Steak or Burgers — Team Quote & NB Battle
competitions.prize: Prime steak for the winning team; burgers for the rest
competitions.description: Every agency is on one of two teams for September, and scoring is by points at the agency level: each quote is worth 1 point and each new business policy is worth 5, counted for September 1–30. The team with the most points eats Prime steak; the other team gets burgers. Teams are being drawn to be as evenly matched as possible and will be posted here along with standings once September scoring is underway.

competitions.title: Jamaica — 2026 Annual Life Promo
competitions.metricLabel: YTD life as of Aug 30 · qualifiers first, then premium
competitions.description: Qualify with $45,000 life premium and 20 I&P. Agents who I&P $70,000 in life premium also bring an agency producer and their guest. Travel likely Jan/Feb 2027. Standings are year-to-date issued-and-paid premium and counts from the district's YTD Life Results as of August 30, listed with qualifiers first and then by premium. Steven Tindell and Jeffrey Pechacek have cleared both bars; Tindell is $5,298 from the $70,000 producer-and-guest tier. Matt Hodges has the premium and is 5 I&P away. FNWL reports are the official source for tracking and disputes are settled at the District Manager's discretion. No cash in lieu, no refunds or credits if the trip is not taken, and the agent must be in good standing with Farmers at the time of travel.
